name: MN-05
label: Safe D

model.rationale: The D+32 district fundamentals, Omar's incumbency and roughly eight-to-one cash advantage, and Polymarket pricing near 95% all point to a comfortable Democratic hold; no evidence justifies moving materially from the baseline.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or a major outside-spending intervention against Omar could narrow the margin, though not plausibly enough to flip the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Minneapolis-based MN-05 is one of the most Democratic districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+32. Incumbent Ilhan Omar is running for reelection and has raised about $5.8 million, with $1.3 million on hand. Republican John Nagel has raised about $747,000 but reports only about $47,000 in cash, with no outside spending on either side.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and money. Prediction markets put Omar's chances around 95%. The seat is expected to remain safely Democratic, with Omar favored by roughly 30 points.
